description: The file defines an Android IntentService called DeleteQuestionService that interacts with Google Play Services Wearable API to update data items, specifically marking a question as deleted on a connected wearable device.

classes.name: DeleteQuestionService
classes.description: An IntentService that updates the question status on a connected wearable device by setting a 'question was deleted' flag in the data layer.

methods.name: DeleteQuestionService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with its class name.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient with Wearable API and connection callbacks.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles the intent to mark a question as deleted by updating the data item via the Wearable DataApi.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback for when GoogleApiClient is connected (empty in this implementation).

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback for when the connection is suspended (empty in this implementation).

methods.description: Callback for when the connection attempt fails (empty in this implementation).
